 Call of Duty Mobile Season 10 Brings Verdansk to Battle Royale
 COD Mobile Season 10 brings Verdansk, updated movement, and new Battle Royale systems. Learn more about the 7th Anniversary update changes.
 On November 4, the Call of Duty team announced upcoming mobile Battle Royale changes on its official website. The season officially kicks off in one week on November 11th at 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
 Season 10 marks a huge update for Battle Royale, bringing a new big map plus changes to the UI, gameplay mechanics, movement, and more, including:
 New animations for 3 rd person view on Verdansk and in DMZ
 Updated movement and airborne controls
 Parachutes can be deployed in-match in Verdansk, replacing wingsuits
 Doors can be shoulder bashed open if you run through them
 Players can now drag downed teammates while reviving them
 Take on in-game contracts for rewards
 Updated UI and lobby scenes
 RELATED: How To Get Free COD Mobile Points—All Active CODM Promo Codes 
 What Is New in COD Mobile Season 10?
 Season 10 brings a brand-new map, Verdansk, to the game. The map features more than 15 points of interest.
 The Call of Duty team touts unique, highly detailed features at each point of interest on Verdansk. These include the TV station, prison, hospital, superstore, and more.
 You can see the full list below:
 Superstore
 Airport
 Storage Town
 Dam
 Scrapyard
 Train Station
 TV Station
 Promenade
 Hospital
 Downtown
 Park
 Port
 Prison
 Farmland
 Stadium
 Lumber
 Quarry
 Military Base
 The map also includes a story-based event that rewards a Ghost Operator Skin and a Legendary Assault Rifle Blueprint.
 Players can also look forward to two new Mythic Drops: Means to an End and Botanist . The season also features several events, including a Ford Racing collaboration event. 
 A week after season launch, you’ll be able to experience the Ford Racing collaboration through this task-based event. Move through milestones by completing basic tasks like logging in, playing matches, and getting kills in any mode. This can earn you over 20 rewards, including the Urban Tracker — Pit Crew Operator Skin, Rallycar — Sports Mode Vehicle Skin, and the weapon DRH — Command Console Weapon Blueprint.
 The season also includes a wide variety of new weapons and more. Those interested can check out the official post for more.
 What do you think about these additions to Call of Duty Mobile? Share your thoughts on this story and others like it in our official Discord server.
